headline: The lion, the witch and the warblers: behind the scenes of Handel’s Alcina at the RBO – in pictures
context: The colourful and larger-than-life staging of the opera about an enchantress who transforms her lovers into beasts returns to the Royal Opera stage this week. We went behind the scenes on the final day of rehearsals All photos: Tristram Kenton • Alcina is at the Royal Opera House

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The colourful and larger-than-life staging of the opera about an enchantress who transforms her lovers into beasts returns to the Royal Opera stage this week.
